none: PAS BM-E9DD4F: Roman coin: nummus of Constantine I
contea di ritrovamento: Oxfordshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy Roman nummus of Constantine I (AD 306-337), dating to the period AD 321-323 (Reece period 16). The coin has been double struck with a later BEATA TRANQVILLITAS type (AD 321-323) over a SOLI INVICTO COMITI undertype (AD 313-318) that is visible on both faces. Obverse: CONSTA-NTINVS [...], Helmeted and cuirassed bust right. Struck over: [SOLI INVICTO] COMITI reverse type depicting…
